svg.metadata: {"id": "s039", "name": "天平称重台", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "质量", "克与千克", "等式"], "desc": "称重台：等臂托盘天平横梁水平、指针归零，左盘苹果右盘砝码；旁有砝码盒、弹簧秤与装豆子的量罐，适合质量与等式课。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [1080, 1640]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "counter", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "jars", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "spring_scale", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "swing", "depth": null}, {"name": "balance_stand", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "beam_pans", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pointer", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "swing", "depth": null}, {"name": "weight_box", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "digital_scale", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp", "enter": "drop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "glints", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FDEBDD", "wall2": "#F6D6C0", "wains": "#E9B79A", "wains2": "#D99E7E", "counter": "#7A5C9E", "counter2": "#634A84", "top": "#F4EEF8", "brass": "#E6B54E", "brass2": "#C7922E", "brass3": "#FFE29A", "metal": "#8E9AA8", "metal2": "#6B7785", "pan": "#D7DEE6", "scale": "#FFFFFF", "tick": "#3D4B5C", "apple": "#E8483B", "apple2": "#FF8A7A", "pear": "#B7D65A", "leaf": "#4E9E5A", "jar": "#E6F4F7", "bean1": "#C9773F", "bean2": "#F2C14E", "bean3": "#6CC59A", "shelf": "#C08A5E", "shelf2": "#9C6A42", "lamp": "#FFE3A3", "box": "#B9804E", "box2": "#8E5A33", "velvet": "#C8455A", "floor1": "#D7C3B2", "floor2": "#BEA592"}}
